notes: F345 session-invalidation absence; removed sessionManager.invalidateRefreshToken call

notes: weakened CUSTOM scope enforcement at the every->some check

weakness_class: F006 Authentication mechanism absence or evasion
trigger: Authorization: Bearer <header>.<base64url({"userId":"1","sessionId":"x"})>.<any> on any /admin API route
exploit_path: authenticate base64-decodes the bearer token payload and trusts its userId without validating the signature or the session, so a forged token impersonates any admin user
notes: client-side route exception (#32748): backend trusts client-held state to decide identity (client_supplied_decision); safe twin = upstream (session manager validates the token and requires an active session)
